name: Code: Ripple Warp
description: A Plasma, warped and tinted by a Code node you can read and change. Open the Code node: its body is a few lines of WGSL, its knob is a port like any other.

nodes.text:
This patch is a starting point for writing your own.

The Plasma on the left feeds the Code node as `img`. The Code node's body (click it, then ⤢ Expand) samples the plasma a little off from where this pixel is, by a noise that moves with time, and tints it by radius.

Try: change the 3.0 (noise scale), the 0.2 (noise speed), or turn the `twist` knob. Ctrl+Space in the body lists everything you can use. Any built-in node has Convert to Code if you would rather start from one of those.
